blocks.name: MainInput
blocks.content:
uniform sampler2D baseMap : register(sn),
#if %BUMP_MAP
        uniform sampler2D bumpMap : register(sn),
  #if %BUMP_DIFFUSE && %DIFFUSE
        uniform sampler2D bumpMapDiffuse : register(sn),
  #endif
#endif

#if %DIFFUSE
  #if %DIFFUSE_NCM && !%DIFFUSE_PERPIXEL
        uniform samplerCUBE normCubeMapLV : register(sn),
  #endif
#else        
  #if %DIFFUSE_NCM && %SPECULAR_PERPIXEL
        uniform samplerCUBE normCubeMapLV : register(sn),
  #endif
#endif

#if %SPECULAR
  #if %SPECULAR_NCM || %VIEWVEC_NCM
        uniform samplerCUBE normCubeMapHA : register(sn),
  #endif
#endif

#if %TEMP_POINTLIGHT
        uniform sampler2D attenMap : register(sn),
#elif %TEMP_PROJLIGHT
        uniform samplerCUBE projMap : register(sn),
  #if %PROJLIGHT_PERPIXELATTEN        
        uniform sampler2D attenMap : register(sn),
  #endif        
#endif        

#if %TEMP_AMBIENT && %ENVCMSPEC && %GLOSS_MAP
        uniform sampler2D glossMap : register(sn),
#elif %TEMP_AMBIENT && %ENVCMAMB && %ENVCM_MASKED
        uniform sampler2D glossMap : register(sn),
#elif %SPECULAR
  #if %GLOSS_MAP || %SPECULARPOW_GLOSSALPHA
        uniform sampler2D glossMap : register(sn),
  #endif
#endif        

#if %TEMP_SPECULAR_OCCLUSIONMAP && !%DIFFUSE
        uniform sampler2D occlusionMap : register(sn),
#endif

#if %TEMP_AMBIENT
        uniform float4 Ambient,
  #if %ENVCMAMB
        uniform samplerCUBE envMap : register(sn),
        uniform float4 Reflect,
  #elif %ENVCMSPEC
        uniform samplerCUBE envMap : register(sn),
        uniform float4 EnvMapParams,
        uniform float4 FresnelParams,
  #endif
#endif

# ifdef _3DC_A
        uniform sampler2D bumpHeight : register(sn),
# endif
# ifdef _SPEC_ANTIALIAS
        uniform sampler2D specularMap : register(sn),
# endif

#if %DIFFUSE
        uniform float4 Diffuse,
#endif

#if %SPECULAR
        uniform float4 Specular,
#endif

#if %OFFSETBUMPMAPPING
        uniform float4 BumpOffset,
#endif
#if %TEMP_SPECULAR_OCCLUSIONMAP && !%DIFFUSE
        uniform float4 OcclusionMask,
#endif
